message:
Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'set -ex
cd /gt/_work/src
cmake -S . -B /gt/build-msan-static -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DLIBICAL_STATIC=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DLIBICAL_CXX_BINDINGS=OFF -DLIBICAL_JAVA_BINDINGS=OFF -DLIBICAL_BUILD_DOCS=OFF -DLIBICAL_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DLIBICAL_GLIB=OFF -DLIBICAL_GOBJECT_INTROSPECTION=OFF -DLIBICAL_BUILD_TESTING=OFF -DLIBICAL_GLIB_BUILD_DOCS=OFF -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -O1 -g -fPIE -fno-omit-frame-pointer" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -pie" 
ninja -C /gt/build-msan-static -j2 icalvcard-static
ls /gt/build-msan-static/lib
clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -O1 -g -fPIE -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I/gt/build-msan-static/src -I/gt/build-msan-static/src/libical -I/gt/build-msan-static/src/libicalvcard -I/gt/_work/src/src -I/gt/_work/src/src/libical -I/gt/_work/src/src/libicalvcard /gt/libicalvcard_fuzzer.c -o /gt/libicalvcard_fuzzer /gt/build-msan-static/lib/libicalvcard.a /gt/build-msan-static/lib/libical.a -lm -lpthread
/gt/libicalvcard_fuzzer /gt/poc1.vcf -runs=1 >/tmp/out 2>&1; echo exit:$?; grep -n "MemorySanitizer\|WARNING\|vcardstructured" /tmp/out | head -80
'
